newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers hold steady, 380-cst at $123-125.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers hold steady, 380-cst at $123-125.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes hovered around Friday levels in thin talk with activity expected to pick up later Monday, traders said.
Majors quoted bunker 180-cst at $130/$132 per tonne and 380-cst at around $125. Independents were a shade lower at $123-$124 for 380-cst.
Traders said shipowners were making enquiries but most appeared relaxed. Some were keeping a close watch on cargo prices, they said. Cargo swaps were 50 cents firmer on the day.
MDO and gas oil were also steady at $231-$245 and $255-$262 per tonne respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
